rows.text: stores `ecx` to dword `02092744` and `edx` with bit 7 cleared to dword `020927EC`, and rewrites dword `01E0C320` with 0 when bit `0x80` of `dl` is set and with its own current value otherwise
returns in `xmm0` float dword `+0x148` of qword `rcx+0xC0` when that qword is non-null, and 0.0 when it is null

notes: 00254480: the listing decodes 01E0C320's initial value as 0x40; the body reads the current value at entry and writes it back unchanged when bit 7 of dl is clear.
